data: How many subplots are presented in the figure?

The figure contains four subplots labeled A, B, C, and D. Each subplot represents a different aspect of the comparison of statistical models. Subplot A shows the lower bound on marginal log likelihood for a representative bird (BF08), while Subplot B shows the normalized bound on marginal log likelihood for all birds. Subplot C displays cross-validation results for a representative bird (BF08), and Subplot D shows cross-validation results for all birds. Therefore, the total number of subplots in the figure is four.
